title: Princess Y85

specs.Interior: Princess Design Studio, gloss Silver Oak, Walnut floors

highlights: Sleipner vector fin stabilisers with zero-speed stabilisation
Spa bath and GRP hardtop on the flybridge
Third control station in the cockpit
Underwater lights, cockpit servery unit, 34-bottle wine cooler
description:
A 2021 Princess Y85 motor yacht with 525 engine hours, offered for sale in Singapore with an extensive list of factory options.

Powered by twin MAN V12-1800 engines, she is equipped with Sleipner vector fin stabilisers providing roll control both underway and at zero speed, hydraulic bow and stern thrusters, two Onan 27 kW generators and a 190 L/h watermaker.

On deck, the GRP hardtop flybridge features a spa bath and wet bar with icemaker, while the cockpit adds a third control station and a servery unit. An electro-hydraulic bathing platform rated to 550 kg carries a tender or water toys.

Inside, a gloss Silver Oak interior with Walnut floors in the galley and wheelhouse leads to four guest cabins below deck, including a full-beam master stateroom and a starboard cabin that converts to a double. The bathrooms are finished in marble, with Naim audio and Focal speakers throughout. A Seabob F5 SR completes the package.

Contact Yacht Research for the full specification, maintenance records and viewing arrangements.
